Gems
====

[![Gem.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/aa/Gem.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Gem.png)

Gems are a premium currency in Dungeon Defenders 2. You can obtain 450 **Gems** by completing certain [Adventures](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Adventures "Adventures")
 and 150 **Gems** from the [Defender Pass](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Pass "Defender Pass")
.  
They can only be obtained by purchasing them with [real-life currency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Currency)
 in the in-game shop, buying certain DLC's, or Winning them through giveaways.  
Gems can be used to purchase [Heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
, [Shard Packs](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards")
, [cosmetics](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Costumes "Costumes")
 and other items in the [Emporium](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Emporium "Emporium")
.  
  

Best Things to Buy With Gems
------------------------------

1.  Max Bags Bundle
    *   Formula for the cost of the bundle, with b being number of bags owned: `640(8 - b)(0.05b + 0.65)`
2.  Material Vault - 1,450 Gems.
3.  Shard Vault - 1,450 Gems.
4.  Bank Vaults - 640 Gems per vault.
5.  All Heroes Bundle - 3,600 Gems.
6.  Defender Pass - 1,500 Gems
7.  Player Shop Slots - You have 2 slots by default.
    *   Slot 3-8 for [![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Gem_Icon.png)
         50 each.
    *   Slot 9-12 for [![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Gem_Icon.png)
         75 each.
    *   Slot 13-16 for [![Gem Icon.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8d/Gem_Icon.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Gem_Icon.png)
         90 each.
    *   **960 gems in total**
